Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed the WebSurfer to the wrong IMDb title (tt0462590, which corresponds to the 2007 feature film) instead of the 1985 telefilm (tt0088853). This misidentification led to retrieving the 2007 film’s New Zealand filming locations (Auckland) and created the discrepancy, directly causing the wrong location to be considered for the telefilm based on the 1977 Katherine Paterson book.
